info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Business Risk Model Update API allows organizations to modify existing business risk models based on specified identifiers. By utilizing the PATCH method, users can selectively update certain parameters of a risk model to ensure it meets evolving business requirements. This API is particularly useful for finance and risk management teams that need to refine models in response to new data or changing regulations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and analytical teams focused on risk assessment and compliance.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the partial update of a business risk model identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. You can modify specific attributes of the model to adjust its parameters or values based on the latest business insights.
